About

Product across the full cycle

I work across the full product cycle: strategy, requirements, design, development and go-to-market. At ZikPe I own PRDs and feature specs, drive KYC onboarding strategy with identity-verification vendors, and shape the corporate card line - all inside a small startup team where I also contribute hands-on code, interface design and working prototypes.

My toolkit is technical as well as product: SQL and data-driven decision-making, high- and low-level design discussions with engineers, and hands-on prototyping with AI coding tools. Before fintech, I shipped product work in edtech at BYJU'S and in AI analytics at Mactores.
